svg.title: Change propagation moved to the right layer
svg.desc: The left side shows undesirable semantic churn where editing one expression appears to create new identities for statement, function, module, and project. The right side shows the intended model: one local revision change and one new global snapshot, without redefining all conceptual ancestors.
svg.text: Change propagation belongs at the snapshot layer
A deep edit should produce a new global snapshot, but it should not redefine every semantic ancestor as a new conceptual thing.
Avoid: semantic containment as the storage Merkle tree
One expression edit appears to recreate every ancestor identity.
This is technically possible, but it makes continuity harder to express.
Preferred: local revision change + new snapshot
The semantic entities remain stable; only exact state and global resolution change.
The global fingerprint changes because canonical state changed.
Local stability and global certainty are both preserved.
